mechanism: The cognitive process of confirming that a claim or {{artifact}} adheres to its {{spec}} or to reality, regarding an assertion that already exists. Runs via a {{check}}, which may return Unknown. Distinct from {{validate}}, which is syntactic conformance to a schema; Verification is semantic and may reference reality rather than a document.
gloss: Confirming alignment with truth or spec
failure_modes: False positive: artifact accepted despite not meeting spec.
False negative: valid artifact rejected due to overly strict or misapplied criteria.
invariants: A verification states what it was checked against — which {{spec}}, or which observation.
Where the underlying {{check}} yields Unknown, the verification reports Unknown.
The assertion under verification exists before the verification runs.
